name: Screen Sharing System
author: Thomas Lloancy

sections.description:
Screen Sharing System is a WordPress plugin designed to facilitate online collaboration and technical support.

  • Secure Screen Sharing: Connecting is as simple as using a unique 6-digit ID and password, providing a user experience inspired by industry leaders like TeamViewer.
  • Full Communication: Use webcam, microphone, engage in chat discussions, and exchange unlimited files via a secure WSS connection.
  • Flexible Settings: Advanced users can adjust ICE and WebSocket servers to optimize performance according to their specific needs.
  • Responsive Design: Enhanced design for optimal compatibility with all devices, from smartphones to desktop screens.

This plugin is ideal for consultants, educators, technical support teams, and anyone who wants an integrated solution for real-time collaboration on WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org or upload the ZIP file.
  2. Go to ‘Plugins’ in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Click ‘Add New’, then ‘Upload Plugin’, and select the ZIP file.
  4. Install and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I secure my screen share?

The plugin uses a secure WSS protocol and each session has a unique ID and password.

Does this plugin work on all WordPress versions?

The plugin requires at least WordPress 5.0 and has been tested up to 6.9.

Can I use this plugin for group sessions?

Currently, the plugin is optimized for one-on-one sessions, but additional features are in development.

  • Added session recording feature using the MediaRecorder API (share or view side).
  • Added self-hostable Node.js signaling server with Docker support (see signaling-server/ folder).
  • Verified and confirmed compatibility with WordPress 7.0.

  • File Transfer drastically optimized.

1.2.2

  • Verified and confirmed compatibility with WordPress 6.9.

1.2.1

  • Added binaryType configuration to resolve compatibility issues with Chrome when receiving blobs or ArrayBuffers.
